name: pi-goal-x
notes: v0.31.6 sync: adopted upstream's prompt-cache fix (#67/#68): context hook appends live goal state at the request tail (pi-goal-live-context) instead of prepending, compactGoalCheckpointContext rewrites every checkpoint marker in place (no mid-history deletion that shifted the cache prefix), before_agent_start no longer injects changing state into the system prompt, and cacheGoalHistory moves existing Anthropic/Bedrock cache breakpoints before the transient tail. Fork additions preserved: persisted pi-goal-context-event channel (re-sent on session_compact), pi-goal-state-event snapshots, ui_prompt_start/end Escape-to-dialog depth (reset on session_start), change-manifest baseline capture, constant tool-surface install (installGoalTools); goal-context-filter.test.ts rewritten for compactGoalCheckpointContext semantics. Missing upstream APIs re-added: shouldInjectPostCompactReminder, buildPostCompactionGoalDelta, armPostCompactReminder/isPostCompactReminderPending/clearPostCompactReminder/consumePostCompactReminder were absent in the fork's v0.31.5 sync and are now restored. Known pre-existing debt (not from this sync): tests/goal-auditor-package.test.ts D-04/D-05 fail because pi-subagents 0.15.0 injects contact_supervisor into the goal-auditor declaredBuiltin list. Known new debt (upstream-original, left unchanged per debt policy): pi-lens findings on run-gate.mjs (JSON.parse without try/catch), goal-prompt-cache.ts (no-unknown-returns), goal-prompt-cache-sdk.test.ts, and goal-prompt-cache.test.ts. 2026-09-19 conflict-surface pass: package-lock.json restored to upstream bytes (pnpm monorepo never reads it; restore again after each pull); catch-comment/indentation noise reverted (goal-prompts.ts keeps upstream space-indent inside cachedPrompt/retainedTaskChars; goal-policy.ts byte-identical); the post-compact reminder tests removed during the v0.31.5 gap were restored (goal-policy.test.ts, goal-accounting-runtime.test.ts). tsconfig target stays ES2023 deliberately — reverting to ES2022 breaks typecheck. Fork settings cases moved from tests/goal-layered-settings.test.ts (byte-identical to upstream again) to fork-only tests/goal-fork-settings.test.ts (registered in .test-manifest.json). Copy note: pausedGateBlock/budgetReachedReminderNote/auditorRejectionNote wording is duplicated inline in goal-events.ts currentGoalContext — three same-source copies; if upstream rewords the policy text, sync the snapshot side. 2026-09-19 P2 pass: the pi-subagents delegation executor (runGoalCompletionAuditor, structured-result parsing, usage/progress handling) moved from extensions/goal-auditor.ts to fork-only extensions/goal-auditor-delegation.ts; goal-auditor.ts keeps prompt building, AuditorProgress types and re-exports so goal-completion.ts/goal-oracle.ts and most tests need no import changes (tests/goal-auditor.test.ts imports shifted).
